Initial public release for jailbroken PS5 consoles, tested on firmware 8.20.

- Native H.264 and HEVC video decoding with Jellyfin conversion for unsupported media.
- DualSense trigger resistance and pressure-sensitive seeking.
- Per-series autoplay with Up Next and inactivity prompts.
- Separate Movies, Series and Episodes search rows using the PlayStation keyboard.
- Metadata-based Skip Intro, resume playback, audio/subtitle selection and a server dashboard.

Install the complete folder ZIP in `/data/homebrew/PPSA99001`.
See the setup and compatibility guides for supported media and output limits.
